The 94,873-byte capture in the seed basis was dominated by `.seeds/issues.jsonl` hunks whose single changed lines embed whole seed bodies; the 30-CHANGED-LINE cap bounds line COUNT, not bytes, so a pathological single multi-KB line still passes through — HARD_CAP remains the only byte-level guard.

This review's own prompt preamble was truncated at the 48 KB ceiling, cutting off the tail of the develop reviewer.md input text; the diff itself was fully readable, so verification completed, but the truncation means later input sections (e.g. tail of Input list) were judged from the loop-lane copy.

Minor non-blocking nit: capped-diff-walk drops a file from `included` when git diff exits non-zero, reporting it as omitted — same behavior as diff-walk, so consistent, but a non-zero diff exit on a listed file surfaces as 'UNSEEN' rather than an error.
